How Australian property managers run virtual rental inspections

Give interstate and relocating applicants one browser walkthrough link before they apply, instead of repeating live video calls. Domain’s bundled Matterport coverage applies only to residential sale listings, so rental teams get better reach by placing an unlisted 3D walkthrough link inside inspection replies, SMS follow-ups, 2Apply and InspectRealEstate workflows, and by adding a YouTube walkthrough video in the portal video field.

By Yo-Da Lai, founder of Veylet · Updated 25 November 2026

Why rentals hit the inspection bottleneck first

Leasing turnaround moves faster than sales campaigns, and a single vacated home rarely justifies a $200–$400 photographer dispatch on every turnover. Yet relocating tenants still hesitate to submit an application without checking kitchen bench space, hallway width or natural light.

  • Domain’s bundled Matterport covers sales, not rentals. Domain’s published terms exclude rental properties from its Platinum Edge Matterport Suite inclusion.
  • Portal 3D integrations are restricted. realestate.com.au shows 3D tours only from listed suppliers, leaving most property managers falling back on ad-hoc phone video calls.
  • Repeated live video calls waste leasing hours. One self-captured browser walkthrough answers layout questions once for every enquiry that week.

A practical four-step rental walkthrough workflow

When a home is vacant between tenancies—or once the landlord and any current tenant have given written consent—an office captures the property in a few minutes during routine entry or ingoing inspection:

  1. Capture between tenancies. Walk each room at an unhurried pace, capture both sides of doorways cleanly, and check the phone readiness check before leaving the property. Send from the app: it uploads in the background. Check your account for rendering status.
  2. Review for privacy before sharing. Inspect the rendered walkthrough before tapping Approve and share so no mail, personal documents, keys, alarm panels or occupied tenant belongings stay visible. Keep our privacy checklist handy.
  3. Drop the unlisted link into inspection workflows. Paste the browser walkthrough link into enquiry replies, InspectRealEstate booking confirmations, 2Apply follow-ups and open-home signboards. Applicants open it in Safari or Chrome with zero app download or login.
  4. Turn sharing off once leased. Pause or revoke the sharing link in your desk when the tenancy signs so former listings stop circulating cleanly.

Putting a walkthrough video on your portal listing

Alongside the private browser link for direct applicants, both major portals accept a standard 16:9 video in their listing media fields without supplier approval:

  • realestate.com.au Video URL. Upload a 16:9 video to your office’s YouTube channel set to Public or Unlisted (never Private) and paste the URL into Agent Admin or your CRM (PropertyMe, VaultRE, Rex or Agentbox).
  • Domain Video Tour. Paste a direct https:// YouTube or Vimeo link into the Video Tour field in Domain Agent Admin or your CRM.

Tenant consent and state-based sight-unseen rules

In Australia, rental inspection marketing requires landlord permission, written tenant consent when occupied (under state residential tenancies rules), and disclosure of what the walkthrough omits—for example, outdoor areas, smell, street noise or maintenance items outside the scan. A virtual walkthrough informs applicants; lease terms decide when an in-person inspection or statutory condition report still applies.

Not yet proven: Veylet’s own captures are still under quality review, and Veylet has no property-portal integration today.

Questions property managers ask

Does Domain include Matterport 3D tours for rental listings?

No. Domain states that its Platinum Edge Matterport Suite inclusion applies to eligible residential sale listings and is not available for rentals, commercial listings, projects or vacant land.

How can property managers share a virtual inspection without a portal 3D integration?

Share one unlisted browser link in SMS and email inspection replies, booking confirmations in tools such as InspectRealEstate and 2Apply, PropertyMe virtual tour fields, and on your own agency website. Applicants open it in a browser without installing an app.

Can property managers add a walkthrough video to a rental listing on realestate.com.au or Domain?

Yes. Both portals let offices paste a public or unlisted YouTube link (or Vimeo on Domain) into the listing video field from Agent Admin or a synced property management CRM.
